_comment: Q-026 blessed-library slice — PlainTextDocument. The simplest of the six blessed schemas: a String-typed Schema with no invariants beyond the underlying String type itself. Demonstrates that a Schema may carry zero invariants and still serve as a canonical named type (PlainTextDocument vs. raw String) for documentation and downstream programs that compose schemas. The companion 59-non-empty-text-pass and 60-non-empty-text-fail demonstrate the NonEmptyText variant with a real invariant.
